business_problem: Workleap wanted to embed generative AI across its HR and talent-management suite without stitching together separate third-party tools for vector search, full-text search, filtering, and cross-product data retrieval.
solution_summary: Workleap extended its HR and talent-management suite with Workleap AI by layering MongoDB Atlas Search and MongoDB Vector Search onto the Atlas data platform it already used as its system of record. Product data from surveys, feedback, performance reviews, documents, calendars, audio recordings, and other connected business systems stays in Atlas, where hybrid search combines lexical matching and semantic retrieval to supply context for AI assistants and analytics. The same retrieval layer lets managers ask natural-language questions across multiple Workleap products, generate performance-review digests, search connected apps, and analyze employee-engagement trends without manually stitching together several datasets. Because storage, vector search, and text search live on one platform, Workleap built its proof of concept in days and moved to production quickly while avoiding a patchwork of third-party vector, filtering, and search tools.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data behind Workleap's HR products and AI experiences.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides relevance-based text retrieval across surveys, documents, and connected product data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Vector Search
solution_components.role: Adds semantic retrieval so Workleap AI can understand meaning across varied employee and product content.

data_flow: Survey responses, feedback, performance-review data, documents, calendar information, and audio recordings remain in MongoDB Atlas, where Atlas Search and MongoDB Vector Search retrieve the most relevant context and feed Workleap AI features that answer questions, summarize data, and recommend actions to managers.
business_outcome: Workleap shipped a proof of concept in a few days, brought Workleap AI to production quickly, improved data retrieval and analysis for managers, and removed manual review work from performance reviews and engagement analysis across a customer base of more than 20,000 companies.
metrics: Workleap is trusted by over 20,000 companies.
